title: AccommodationData
description: Cancer Open Data v2. Places where cancer patients and their companions can stay near the hospitals: free shelters and halfway houses, and paid places with an official page. A null value or an empty list means the information is not given yet: apps should show "Not given".

$schema.description: Path to this file's JSON Schema.

bgImageURL.description: Background image: a path in this API like /images/<Folder>/<file>.webp, or a full https:// URL. Empty if none.

source.description: The place's own website, or the best page about it. null if it has no website.

type.description: Kind of place, e.g. Halfway house, Shelter, Care facility, Hotel.

operator.description: Who runs it, as written by the source. null if not given.

contacts.description: Organization contacts only (no personal numbers of private people). Branch contacts are inside each branch.

branches.description: Each house or building where people stay.

cost.description: Cost as written, e.g. 'Free'. null if not given.

amenities.description: What the place has or gives, one item each, as written by the source, e.g. kitchen, Wi-Fi, parking, free water. Empty if not given.

capacity.description: Rooms, beds or families, as written. null if not given.

type.description: Kind of contact. One fixed list for all datasets.

day.description: Day or days as written by the source, e.g. 'Monday' or 'Monday-Friday'. A day can appear twice for split hours.

timeIn.description: Opening or start time, e.g. '8:00 am'.

timeOut.description: Closing or end time, e.g. '5:00 pm'.

schedule.description: Open days and hours. Closed days are left out.

branchName.description: Name of the branch, e.g. 'Davao City Branch'. null if not given.

landmark.description: A landmark that helps people find it, as written by the source, e.g. 'infront SPMC Hospital'. null if not given.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from an official source or an on-site GPS reading. null if not known.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from an official source or an on-site GPS reading. null if not known.

schedule.description: Open days and hours. null if not known (show "Not given").

sources.description: Links to the pages these facts come from. Empty if no source is given (show "Not given").

lastVerified.description: Date the record was last checked against its sources, YYYY-MM-DD. null if not known.
